Water fluoridation.snippet: Motivated by the Iowa Fluoride Study (IFS), which tracked fluoride intake and dental outcomes from childhood to young adulthood (ages 9, 13, 17, and 23), we analyze dental fluorosis - a condition caused by excessive fluoride exposure during enamel formation.
